page.overview:
What is Foxy the Pirate?

Foxy the Pirate is a major antagonist in Interactive Novel #1: The Week Before. He is an out-of-order, pirate-themed entertainer at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, held in the Pirate Cove stage.

Foxy is a red, pirate-themed, anthropomorphic animatronic fox with a dilapidated and tattered look. He has two fox-like ears with a lighter red inner ear, three small tufts of hair on the very top of his head, two black eyebrows, yellow eyes, and an eye patch covering his right eye. Foxy has large tufts of hair on the lower sides of his head and a long snout. His lower jaw is separated from his head, allowing for his jaw to freely move in an up-and-down motion. He has a single row of sharp white teeth on his upper and lower jaw and what seems to be a tongue printed on the floor of his jaw. His chest is battered, with a large hole in the center, revealing his endoskeleton; parts of his arms also reveal the endoskeleton underneath, with a sharp, silver hook on his right arm and a fully endo hand on his left. His legs lack the bottom half of his suit, revealing the endoskeleton's legs and feet, with the remains of his brown, pant-like suit being tattered, as if they were ripped off.

Ralph told himself to not forget about Foxy. When checking the cams, Foxy begins behind the curtain of Pirate Cove.

IF YOU CHECK THE CAMERAS AGAIN- Before leaving the office, Ralph checks the security monitors to track the animatronics’ movements. Over in Pirate Cove, a pair of glowing white eyes peer from behind the curtain in Pirate Cove and then blink out.
